subject: Implement Typer CLI with test and serve commands
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/__main__.py` with Typer CLI providing test and default serve commands.

Must implement:
- Typer `app` instance
- Default command (no subcommand): starts MCP server with configured transport
- `test` subcommand: tests HANA connection and exits with success/failure code
  - Loads config, creates connection, runs `SELECT 1 FROM DUMMY`, reports result
- `--env-file` option: specify custom environment file path
  - Validates file existence and that it's a regular file
- Logging setup based on config (`LOG_LEVEL`, `LOG_FORMAT`)
- Rich console output for test results (success/failure with connection details)

Reference: mamba-mcp-postgres `__main__.py` for the CLI pattern.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Default invocation starts MCP server
- [ ] `test` subcommand tests connection and reports success/failure
- [ ] `--env-file` option overrides default env file discovery
- [ ] Exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure for `test` command
- [ ] Entry point: `mamba-mcp-hana` console script

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `--env-file` pointing to non-existent file: clear error before any connection attempt
- [ ] `--env-file` pointing to a directory: clear error

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Connection failure in `test`: prints error details, exits with code 1
- [ ] Missing required env vars: prints which vars are missing

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: CLI `test` command with mocked connection (success path)
• Unit: CLI `test` command with mocked connection (failure path)
• Unit: `--env-file` validation logic
• Unit: Default serve command invocation

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.6
